title: EIMA International 2026
summary: Visit Twin Disc at the International Agricultural and Gardening Machinery Exhibition 2026.
body_markdown:
Can’t make it in person? Explore our virtual[On Water](https://twindisc.com/exploremarine/) and[On Land](https://twindisc.com/exploreindustrial/) tradeshows today!


### EIMA International 2026


Event Date : November 10, 2026 - November 14, 2026
Event Location : Viale Aldo Moro, 16, 40127 Bologna BO, Italië


Event Link :[https://www.eima.it/en/](https://www.eima.it/en/)


Twin Disc will be present at **EIMA International 2026 in Bologna** , showcasing its solutions for agricultural and off-highway power transmission at the exhibition from **10–14 November 2026** .
